scripts.dev: echo "Run pnpm --filter @odovi/web dev (or worker/db) — no root dev process"
scripts.test: node --test scripts/check-publication.test.mjs scripts/collect-license-notices.test.mjs scripts/database-backup.test.mjs scripts/check-production-audit.test.mjs scripts/egress-verifier.test.mjs scripts/location-provider-boundary.test.mjs scripts/release.test.mjs acceptance/release-stack/write-manifest.test.mjs && corepack pnpm --filter @odovi/core --filter @odovi/db --filter @odovi/runtime-config build && corepack pnpm -r test
